digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, plan-review gate, completion verifier
propositions: One environment variable (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express different model classes per pass (Pass-1 finder, Pass-2 verifier, Pass-4 coach)
Code-review gate has five LLM-calling steps but only verify declares model explicitly; base, round_a, round_b, and coach inherit cfg.model implicitly
Batch steps (round_a, round_b) require single-rung model_ladder in the batch sub-dict, not step-level model key, because interpreter.py only reads batch-dict values
On non-default providers (Bedrock), per-step model declarations in YAML were not reaching the runtime resolver, causing all steps to inherit cfg.model
Verifier downgrade from opus to sonnet (Pass-2/Pass-4) only applies when cfg.model equals default_model, breaking on non-default providers and inverting intended class routing
